title: Card database export
description: Template schema. EXTEND IT to fit your game — add your own stat and type fields. What matters is that it is closed, documented, and that cards.json validates against whatever you ship. See reference/01-export-spec.md and reference/02-effect-dsl.md

keyword_glossary.description: Every keyword used by any card, with its EXACT semantics. 'Taunt' is not self-explanatory across games.

id.description: Stable and never reused. Replays reference this.

enabled.description: false for disabled/removed cards that still appear in old replays

cost.description: Number, or an object for alternate/multi-resource costs

keywords.description: Only mechanics the engine handles generically. Each must appear in keyword_glossary.

effect_dsl.description: Behavior per reference/02-effect-dsl.md, or null if bespoke. NEVER approximate — null is correct, approximate is a silent wrongness bug.

effect_text_exact.description: The exact in-game card text, verbatim. Required even when effect_dsl is present.

bespoke_reason.description: Required when effect_dsl is null: why it resists the DSL.

trigger.description: on_play, on_death, start_of_turn, continuous, activated, ... Document each in effects.md including whether it fires on both players' events and where it sits in resolution order.

op.description: A primitive from your documented vocabulary

amount.description: Fixed integer, or a dynamic value. Document WHEN a dynamic value is evaluated — on play, on resolution, or continuously. Same text, three different games.

on_no_legal_target.description: fizzle / skip_effect / card_uncastable — the behavior people forget to specify
